summary: The fort itself, from the build menu's pieces (scripts/building/fort_plan.gd stamps them exactly where they are listed when the level is built, free of cost, no checking, no jitter). x, z are fort coordinates (the fort is 32 m square about the origin, the gate in the north wall at z -16), yaw in degrees (a piece is worked from its +Z side: 0 faces south, 180 north, 90 east, -90 west; a palisade's +Z side is the outside). A run is `count` pieces, each (dx, dz) further. Palisade sections are 3 m and the runs are spaced so that their end stakes touch (or overlap a hand's width); the walls stop 10 cm short of the blockhouses at the north-west and south-east corners (a wall through the hollow room would cut it in two) and close the other two corners. The firing step (4 sections each side of the gate: the gate's own module between them), a ramp at the end of each side's step and a ladder in the middle of the second section from the gate, the flag pole in the parade ground.
